nodes.name: Set Manual Status
nodes.notes: PATCH processing_jobs to status=manual for the given mission_id. Signals that this mission type requires manual operator intervention.

parameters.subject: =[Sentinel] Manual Processing Required — Mission {{ $json.mission_number }} ({{ $json.package_type }})
parameters.text:
=Sentinel Aerial Inspections — Manual Processing Required

---

Mission Number: {{ $json.mission_number }}
Package Type: {{ $json.package_type }}
Mission ID: {{ $json.mission_id }}
Folder Path: {{ $json.folder_path }}

---

This mission type ({{ $json.package_type }}) requires manual processing.
The automated pipeline has set the processing status to "manual" and is
awaiting operator action.

Please review the mission data at the folder path above and process
according to the standard operating procedure for {{ $json.package_type }}
missions.

Once processing is complete, update the processing_jobs status in
Supabase to "complete" for mission {{ $json.mission_number }}.

---
Sentinel Automated Pipeline Notification

nodes.name: Notify Operator
nodes.notes: Send email notification to OPERATOR_EMAIL env var recipient. Uses SMTP credential configured in n8n UI.

_meta.description: Shared sub-workflow for Path B (construction) and Path D (ADIAT) manual handling. Sets processing_jobs status to 'manual' and sends operator email notification. Called by Package Router Execute Sub Workflow node.
